subjectTemplate: Your footbag.org profile picture has been removed
bodyTemplate:
Hi {memberName},

An IFPA administrator has removed the profile picture on your account. Your account, your membership and everything else on your profile are unchanged.

Administrator's note:
{note}

You can upload a new picture from your profile edit page. If you believe this was decided in error, submit a contact request from that page.

International Footbag Players Association
